bias.en: Bearish · back above the 5-day, capped at $190–192
bias.zh: 看空 · 重回 5 日均线上方，受制于 $190–192

read.en: Arm rose 6.7% on Nov 9 to $186.30, trading $174.76–190.02. It closed above the falling 5-day ($184.39) but below the falling 10-day ($201.60), 30-day ($239.37) and 100-day ($269.79) and the rising 200-day ($231.18). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($220.78), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Arm 11月9日上涨 6.7%，收于 $186.30，盘中区间 $174.76–190.02。收盘站上下行的 5 日均线（$184.39），但仍位于下行的 10 日（$201.60）、30 日（$239.37）和 100 日均线（$269.79）以及上行的 200 日均线（$231.18）下方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$220.78），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The rally cleared the $175.8–177.6 resistance and the $183.2 Oct 27, 2025 high, now support; the $190.02 high stopped at the $189.9–191.8 zone. Resistance is $189.9–191.8 (Nov 4 low and close), then $196.1–196.8 (Nov 2 low and close) and $201.6 (10-day). Support is $183.2–184.4, then $174.8–177.6 and $169.6. A close above $191.8 would target $196–201.6; below $183.2, $175–177.6.

r.en: Nov 4 low $189.9; Nov 4 close $191.8; Nov 9 high $190.02
